ACTION=A2
Rationale: A motorcycle is executing a cut-in maneuver from the right (y=3.5m) into the ego vehicle's path (y=0.0m) starting at x=23.0m. Given the ego vehicle's speed of 30 kph and the motorcycle's higher speed of 9 m/s (32.4 kph), the motorcycle will quickly close the distance and enter the lane. Decelerating (A2) is the appropriate action to maintain a safe following distance and avoid a collision as the motorcycle completes its lane change.
